Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a sales and use tax exemption for tangible personal property sold for charitable purposes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a sales and use tax exemption for tangiblepersonal property sold for charitable purposes; adding a new section tochapter 82.08 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 82.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to the sale oftangible personal property if the gross proceeds of sales are donatedto a nonprofit organization, as defined in RCW 82.04.3651. A persontaking the exemption under this section must keep records necessary forthe department to verify eligibility.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of this chapter do not apply to the use of tangiblepersonal property if the consideration paid by the person to acquirethe property is donated to a nonprofit organization, as defined in RCW p. 1 HB 305782.04.3651.
